name: dma-insights learning rubric
applies_to: every learning note, rulebook refinement and fix, before the rectifier commits it
below_threshold: not admitted — returns to the adversarial enrich-and-adjudicate loop with per-dimension scores as the work order

dimensions.criterion: root-cause correctness: the change repairs the mechanism that produced the finding, not the instance in front of it
the change binds every future run — the next submission is not free to regress
grounded in recorded findings with re-runnable measurements, weighed honestly — recurrences over first sightings, counts with denominators over impressions
fails-before/passes-after: a check exists that fails on the state that produced the finding and passes on the fixed state, and runs unattended
every check offered as evidence examined its subject and could have been red
contribution to the AE storyline — the change moves the learning curve the convergence thresholds measure
nothing previously admitted breaks: the full regression corpus still passes and no existing check was weakened

anchors.label: pre-fix tile state
anchors.quote: the pre-fix tile state (MEM-0095 — two factor vocabularies for one number, no gate) — root-cause absent, regression coverage absent

anchors.label: hand-fixed tiles without CG-31
anchors.quote: the hand-fixed tiles without CG-31 — target fixed, no regression coverage, fails 'generalization' (next submission free to regress)

anchors.label: CG-31 as landed
anchors.quote: CG-31 as landed (apps/mcp/dma_mcp/validation2.py:1493, nine tests, legacy names refused BY NAME) — root cause, coverage, and non-regression all present

convergence.near_clean: <=2 blocking reasons, none in a learned class, repaired without re-synthesis
convergence.learned_class_recurrence: 0 across the final two learned clients AND the held-out
convergence.declining_baseline: Logix round-1 ~ dozens of owner reports across 5 rounds; Baxter re-promote under new gates = 80→47→21→1→0 reasons paid in one day (measured 2026-08-19)

anti_gaming.duty: flag any refinement that weakens detection, trivialises a test, or inflates its own coverage claim
anti_gaming.effect: any flag caps admitted at false regardless of the weighted total

case_generation.law: every case must be able to FAIL — a case that cannot fail is rejected
case_generation.negative_control: at least one case per refinement carries fails_before=true: it fails on the pre-fix state and passes on the fixed state
